description: Android activity class for scanning and displaying Bluetooth LE devices, including UI handling, Bluetooth initialization, and device list management.

classes.name: DeviceScanActivity
classes.description: Main activity for scanning Bluetooth LE devices, managing UI, and handling Bluetooth operations.

classes.name: LeDeviceListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing the list of Bluetooth devices found during scanning.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: Helper class for optimizing list item view handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, checks Bluetooth support, and sets up Bluetooth adapter.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu and updates UI based on scanning state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for starting/stopping scan.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Ensures Bluetooth is enabled, initializes device list, and starts scanning.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result of Bluetooth enable request.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops scanning and clears device list.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a device to connect.

methods.name: scanLeDevice
methods.description: Starts or stops Bluetooth LE device scanning.
